Also a few achievements have been changed to use steam stats, so you can keep track of your progress towards certain achievements.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Controller support added!
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Added full controller support (even menus can be navigated with the thumbstick or d-pad!). Ideal for steams 'big picture' mode!
    [*]Fixed a bug where enemies would keep attacking during the exit cutscene on stage 5/
    [*]You can no longer shoot through one of the doors in the arena level/
[/list] 

With this patch, the keybindings in the game may mess up if a file called Input.ini is not automatically updated. To fix this, navigate to C:\Users\	[b]USER[/b]\AppData\Local\Overdosed\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor and delete Input.ini then load up the game and it should be re-created correctly.

    [*]Newly spawned enemies now have slow effect if in matrix mode

Some enemies may get bunched up and stuck, I'll be fixing this soon so get some easy kills while it lasts :D
